title: Zero Temperature, Degenerate Fermion Stars
summary: We study a zero temperature, degenerate, fermion gas with fermions of rest mass $m$, that only interacts with itself, gravitationally. We describe a self-consistent novel approach to the formation of a degenerate, quantum mechanical, star. In this approach, the fermions occupy the energy levels that are determined by the self consistent gravitational interactions, according to the Pauli exclusion principle. Then the size of the highest occupied level determines the radius of the star. In the Newtonian gravitational limit, the fermions feel a potential corresponding to a simple harmonic well…
